$comment: E-046a Slice 5b-i (readers + reports consumption). Documentation/test-validation only -- no code loads this file at runtime (see strategy-research/CLAUDE.md's 'Schemas are declared but not enforced' note). Shape grounded in S1_FINDINGS.md §7's proposed schema, itself grounded against STRATEGY_DESIGN_GUIDE.md's 'Component variant patterns' section (kind:patch vocabulary) and §7c's block_manifest.yaml contract (kind:new_block vocabulary -- §7c is built since 2026-09-24: stage 1b writes a run's real block_manifest.yaml, checked by tools/block_manifest.py; a reader proposing kind:new_block only sketches IN that vocabulary and writes no manifest). One entry in the list written by a workflow_artifacts/skills/readers/<category>-reader/SKILL.md skill to artifacts/proposals/<category>.yaml.
title: proposals/<category>.yaml entry
description: A single evidence-grounded proposal from one of the 5 specialist readers (profitability, trade_efficiency, forecast_power, regime_power, component_attribution). A reader proposes evidence plus a patch/new_block sketch -- it does NOT decide an idea's status (that is the grid, idea_status.yaml) and never routes. Its scores only rank candidates for the decide-next step (delivery_plan_v26.md slice 6b; E-046a realignment 2026-09-23). Loaded and validated by tools/reader_proposals.py.

kind.description: patch: a Component variant pattern (STRATEGY_DESIGN_GUIDE.md 'Component variant patterns') against an existing component. new_block: a block_manifest.yaml-shaped sketch (STRATEGY_DESIGN_GUIDE.md §7c) for a not-yet-existing component/regime block.

patch.description: Required, non-empty, when kind=patch; must be absent when kind=new_block. A before/after component-spec diff in STRATEGY_DESIGN_GUIDE.md's 'Component variant patterns' vocabulary (e.g. a scaling_factor sign flip, an atr_multiplier/threshold_filter adjustment) -- not a raw unstructured diff.

component_id.description: The component (or regime-config block) the change applies to.

field.description: Dotted path of the changed parameter within that component, e.g. transforms[2].params.min_abs. Required so a proposed change names exactly what it changes.

block.description: Required when kind=new_block; must be absent when kind=patch. A block_manifest.yaml-shaped sketch (STRATEGY_DESIGN_GUIDE.md §7c, built: stage 1b writes the real block_manifest.yaml and tools/block_manifest.py checks it; this proposal field is only a sketch for a human/5b-ii reviewer -- no code registers it as a block).

kind.description: block_manifest.yaml's OWN kind field (forecast|regime) -- distinct from this proposal's top-level kind (patch|new_block). Do not conflate the two vocabularies.

requires_feed.description: OPTIONAL, orthogonal to kind (E-035 S2c, delivery_plan_v26.md slice 8.2): this proposal needs a data feed the engine may not have. Emitted only when this category's own report shows the missing data would plausibly change the result -- never invented. After the specialist_readers stage validates the proposals, each one carrying this field appends one row to campaign_record/data_requests.yaml (stage specialist_reader); decide_next marks a candidate from it INFEASIBLE with reason requires_feed:<feed> until <feed> is a key of trading-bot/data/feed_registry.py's FEED_REGISTRY (the feed set the data-availability gate uses). A reader never decides the idea's status or route with it.

feed.description: The feed's name as a strategy config's aux_feeds entry would name it (a FEED_REGISTRY key, e.g. funding_rate, fear_greed), or a new lowercase snake_case name for a feed that does not exist yet (e.g. open_interest, order_book_depth, liquidations).

reason.description: Why this proposal needs that feed, tied to this report's evidence. Non-empty.

evidence.description: Each item must be traceable to a specific field in THIS category's own artifacts/reports/<category>.yaml (build_reports.py's real output shape) -- e.g. 'slices.per_window[2].core.cost_drag_pct=91.4'. A reader must never cite another category's report, verdict_interpretation.yaml, or verdict-interpreter's retired prose -- each reader's own SKILL.md Forbidden section enforces this at authoring time; this field's non-empty requirement is the mechanical backstop.

scores.description: 0-3 anchored scores -- see each reader SKILL.md's own 'Scoring (0-3 anchors)' table. Do not free-hand; pick from the anchor table by what the report's own fields show.

confidence_real.description: Is this evidence real and corroborated across multiple report slices, or thin/noisy/single-cell?

distance_to_profitable.description: How close is the cited metric to a genuinely passing/profitable state if this proposal were realized?

mechanism_plausibility.description: Does the evidence support a real causal story tied to a specific config element, or a single-cell curve-fit coincidence?

model_id.description: Identifier of the model that authored this proposal (e.g. a Claude model string).

rubric_version.description: Version tag of the scoring rubric used, e.g. 'profitability-reader-v1'. Bump per-reader when a Scoring table changes.
